title: Advanced WASM Operations

tasks.description: LU decomposition (WASM) - implement LU factorization with partial pivoting in AssemblyScript
QR decomposition (WASM) - implement Householder QR decomposition in AssemblyScript
Matrix inversion (WASM) - implement matrix inversion using LU decomposition
Determinant (WASM) - implement determinant calculation using LU decomposition
Bind to WASMBackend - connect LU, QR, Cholesky, inv, det WASM functions to WASMBackend interface
Accuracy tests vs JS - verify WASM decompositions match JS reference to numerical precision

successCriteria: LU decomposition produces correct L, U, P factors
QR decomposition satisfies A = QR and Q'Q = I
Matrix inversion satisfies A * inv(A) = I
Determinant matches expected values for test matrices
WASM results match JS within 1e-10 relative tolerance
notes: Sprint 7 implements advanced linear algebra operations in WASM. Added matrix inversion (luInverse) and convenience determinant function. Extended WASMBackend with qrDecomposition, choleskyDecomposition, inverse, and determinantWasm methods with JS fallbacks. Created comprehensive accuracy tests covering LU, QR, Cholesky decompositions, matrix inversion, and determinant calculations. All 175 matrix tests pass.
